items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1959-01-17
items.q: And the rhythm section was me on, I was playing banjo and guitar in those days, on banjo and guitar. Alfred William on drum, Simon Moreira on bass and Alec Grutter on piano.

ctx.x: You never did join the WPA band then?

No, I was going to say, I always thought that was a little too slow money for me. I, I, well I should have because there wasn't nothing to it, you know. Most of the guys got in just for the money of it, you see. But like I say, then I was doing a little range, I was selling arrangements around you and everything, you know. But I, I, in other words, I was doing it just as good as those guys there, you see. So, and then another thing I, I didn't like it because the time that, like, you would get a good job, it…

items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1961-01-29
items.q: And in the rhythm section were Alla Greta on piano. He was very young. He was one of the young fellas. And Alfred William was on drums, Simon Moreau on bass, and me on banjo.

ctx.x: Yeah, he was arranging for the band. And in the band I remember well, there was Peter On the Leader, a violin player. The sax section was Arthur Durbin, Elliot Taylor, and Joe Ruzon. Elliot Taylor played Clannett in sax at that time. It was very good. I think Arthur Durbin was the first sax and he did a little singing. And in the rhythm section were Alla Greta on piano. He was very young. He was one of the young fellas. And Alfred William was on drums, Simon Moreau on bass, and me on banjo. I was playing banjo…
